input.intent: diagnose bacteremia organism and recommend antibiotic therapy

expected.notes: Paper states MB[h,e]=0.7 for the streptococcus rule (p.247). The expert gave '7 out of 10' certainty (p.238 fn4). Therapy CF 0.9 is from the existing fixture (rule-71-class); the 1975 paper does not number the therapy rule explicitly — that numbering appears in Shortliffe 1976 dissertation. Combined CF via accumulation formula: CF_final = CF_old + CF_new*(1-CF_old) is the update law described in the full MYCIN system.

citation: Shortliffe, E. H., & Buchanan, B. G. (1975). A model of inexact reasoning in medicine. Mathematical Biosciences, 23(3–4), 351–379. Reprinted as Chapter 11 in: Buchanan, B. G., & Shortliffe, E. H. (Eds.), Rule-Based Expert Systems. Addison-Wesley, 1984.
